description: Full-text search across 250M+ scholarly works in OpenAlex: title, authors, year, venue, type, citation count, open-access status with PDF link, reconstructed abstract (up to 1500 chars) and topics. Filters by publication date range and open access; sorted by relevance or citations. Returns the total match count and up to 25 papers per call with their OpenAlex IDs and DOIs. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

open_access.description: true to return only open-access works, false for closed only (optional)

q.description: Search terms (title, abstract and full text)

since.description: Earliest publication date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

until.description: Latest publication date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

name: papers_search
title: papers_search
